lines.t: We lift our eyes beyond the burning sky
Paths shaking stars and falling light
Kingdom of Yahushua, Yahuwah
Draw near
Make this broken cosmos bright
Slow tides of glory roll through the night
Soft pads shimmer with your light
Planets tremble but our hearts stay still
Hidden in the center of your world
Galaxies swirl in a holy dance
Every orbit moves by more than chance
From the dust of ruins you raise us home
Gentle bass breathing, pulling us along
Hearing the choir, between the quakes
Your whisper is the ground that never breaks
House beat, heartbeat, under star-filled air
We float in your presence everywhere
Yahweh, center of it all
From the smallest spark to the cosmic wall
Yahweh, lover of the weak
In the war of worlds, it's your peace we seek
Kingdom rivers through the milky way
Chill step oceans where we kneel and pray
Every drop of light, every distant sun Echoes of the lamb who has overcome me
Soft kicks I chain to your breath Grace in the space between life and death
Warm moody 4,000 hearts in time
But the lead lines you
Holy and still here
No stained glass here
Only open skies
Church without walls
And your endless heights
From Dallas streets to Oregon's rim
One lowly bright eyes locked on him
We don't fear the shaking of the spheres
You've numbered all our days in tears
In the graceful sea of crystal glass
Your mercy waves are all that last
Oh, sender of it all
From the smallest spark to the cosmic wall
Yeah, oh, our lover of the week
In the war of worlds, it's your peace we seek
Kingdom rivers through the Milky Way
Chill step oceans where we kneel and pray
Every drop of light, every distant sun
Echoes of the Lamb who has over been you
Holy, holy
Through the endless blue
Galactic sanctuary
All in you
Thank you.
